spiritgiven.comments: It was a very good communication on and outside the field:)

In the first few points we really liked the spirit of the game. But after that the „rules, knowledge and use“ and „fair mindedness“ went down a lot. How you did the double team was unspirited. It can‘t be that we point it out to your captain, spirit captain and coaches several times and it toke all a lot of time till it changed. From our perspective this gave you an unfair advantage.  Thank you for you good communication. Except this issue we like the game a lot and enjoyed your attitude.

1. you didn‘t know how to handle marking infractions/double teaming and the stopped which is unnecessary.
2. Discussions were too long. Players of your team involved themselfes which we mentioned to not do in pre-spirit circle.
Otherwise well played and congrats on the win! SUI X
We think it was really nice to communicate with the Spirit Captains and the Players:)
You had a very good Team Spirit:)

Thank you for this amazing and from your side really high spirited game. We enjoyed playing against you and thank you for trying to push us up!! You truly did a great job, go for 9th!!! And sorry again for our performance. Lots of love, SUI X
We really liked how motivated you where, even if you where not winning. Also wenn liked your Team atmosphere
We thought there where 1 or 2 not 100% necessary calls. But all the Rest was really really nice, high spirited and we really liked to Play against you. Thank you for that Game.

spiritreceived.comments:
Switzerland, thank you so much for this amazing first game of the tournament. We thought it was a very good game, spirit wise and game wise. We want to again thank you a lot for this game and we hope to play you again this tournament.
Greetings, Netherlands Mixed :)
Great game! We talked about the contact at half and great job improving it!
For the 1 they seemed to be visibly angry and doing things such as kicking the floor, cursing and throwing hats.
Great game! You were  really careful on us you were fighting till the end:)

Thank you Switzerland for this amazing game awesome spirit on the sidelines and overall great attitude towards the game as well. All calls and any issues regarding spirit were resolved quickly. Thank You Switzerland for this great game and good luck!!

Swiss Mixed, thank you for this amazing rematch, as i already said in the spirit circle it is very nice to see that your team really grew during the tournament. We really liked your positivity and your awareness with contact. Congratulations on this very deserved win and we hope to see some of you next year!
Greetings NED Mixed :)
